messages.author: 8af2be9fd00b2274
messages.subject: Welcome
parts:
Hi there,

I should have done that a long time ago already, but here we are:
I have created a Google Group to organise and store all exchanges about IsoriX.

If you see this message, then you should be part of this group too.
I have so far only invited the few persons who emailed me very recently about Isorix.

I hope that this will become the main place where discussions about IsoriX will take place.

The idea is for users to ask all the questions they have. For whoever knows a little more to answer those questions. And hopefully this is also where people will share their experience and let others what they use IsoriX for.

Feel free to let your interested colleagues know about this mailing list.
The more members will join, the better it should become for everyone.

Best,

Alex
